about_the_game:
• The current trial version includes 2 optional characters.

  • Please select "Language" in the "Setting" section to modify the language

Grip your sword tightly, your god is hidden among their corpses.

                                                                                                                                  

"God Bless Your Sword" is an action rougelite game where you will face waves of incoming enemies in the arena, each with different attack modes. The more enemies you have, the more coins and experience points you will earn, but they will become stronger over time. Only by balancing risk and reward can you achieve victory.

Choose your talent

You can gain a talent with each upgrade, and each character has a special talent pool that will strengthen your character from various angles (the talents you can obtain are limited, please make a reasonable choice)

Choose your skills

After clearing a wave of enemies, you can choose a skill once. Each character has a special skill pool, which is different from talent. Skills need to be actively released, and higher-level skills only have a chance to be obtained after low-level same skills are acquired.

Choose your enemy

After clearing each wave of enemies, you need to choose the next wave of enemies, and you will receive corresponding gold coins based on the strength of the selected enemies. The waves with special icons represent the ability to spend coins to obtain additional resources after clearing enemies.
